The Staff Engineer provides technical leadership across the Value Stream and Capabilities, supporting architectural alignment, engineering best practices, and scalable delivery.
They collaborate closely with the Principal Engineer, Delivery Lead, Lead Product Owner, and Solution/Enterprise Architects to shape the technical roadmap, oversee the quality of engineering outputs, and support delivery of complex initiatives aligned to target architecture and engineering strategy.
As a champion of engineering excellence, the Staff Engineer drives the adoption of modern design patterns, cloud-native approaches, and continuous improvement initiatives, contributing to Admiral√¢¬Ä¬ôs long-term technology goals. They also play a key role in mentoring and coaching engineers, supporting capability growth and ensuring consistency in practices across squads.
Main Duties
Leadership
- Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineers across the Value Stream.
- Mentor engineers within your area of expertise to support their technical growth.
- Support the Principal Engineer and senior leadership team with technical risk management, strategy, and decision-making.
- √¢¬Ä¬ãHelp shape epics and technical deliverables in alignment with roadmap goals.
- Own technical dependencies and contribute to planning cycles including Quarterly Alignment, Monthly Value Stream Planning, and Sprint Planning.
Implementation & Delivery
- Contribute to the detailed design, engineering quality, and technical oversight of solutions delivered within the Value Stream.
- Drive improvements to CI/CD pipelines, automation, testing practices, and secure delivery.
- Lead on resolving technical constraints, blockers, and integration challenges.

- Oversee vulnerability management by promoting secure development practices and robust solution design.
- Identify and implement continuous improvements to delivery and engineering processes.
Collaboration & Communication
- Facilitate clear communication across squads and roles to ensure alignment and knowledge transfer.
- Promote engineering values such as transparency, quality, openness, and productivity.
- Collaborate with key technical stakeholders including Architecture, Information Security, Data Governance, and Heads of Capabilities.
- Contribute to communities of practice, Chapter and Guild forums, and internal initiatives.
Experience Required
Technical Expertise
- Proven experience in a Senior or Staff Engineer role, ideally within web and mobile application development.
- Deep expertise in React and NestJS, including server-side rendering, state management, and API development.
- Experience designing and operating micro frontend (MFE) architectures, including module federation and independently deployed pipelines.
- Strong background in CI/CD practices, automated testing, and optimised deployment strategies.
- In-depth knowledge of testing frameworks and strategies across unit, integration, E2E, and non-functional domains.
- Extensive experience with cloud-native environments√¢¬Ä¬îpreferably GCP and Azure.
- Skilled in performance optimisation techniques such as caching, code splitting, lazy loading, and real-user monitoring.
- Deep understanding of web and mobile security best practices, including OWASP guidelines, secure authentication and authorisation.
- Experience with containerisation and infrastructure tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform.
- Familiarity with mobile frameworks such as Ionic Capacitor.
- Desirable: Awareness or experience with Guidewire Software products (e.g. PolicyCenter, BillingCenter).
Behavioural Competencies
- Strategic Thinking: Understands how technical decisions support broader business and platform goals.
- Leadership & Mentorship: Actively mentors engineers, shares knowledge, and supports the development of others.
- Collaboration: Works effectively across multiple squads, stakeholders, and functions.
- Accountability: Owns engineering outcomes, promotes high standards, and ensures follow-through on technical commitments.
- Problem Solving: Decomposes complex problems and drives practical, sustainable solutions.
- Continuous Improvement: Seeks and drives opportunities to modernise practices, reduce friction, and improve delivery flow.
- Security & Resilience Mindset: Promotes secure design and robust, scalable architecture.
- Knowledge Sharing: Encourages documentation and collaboration to eliminate single points of failure and strengthen team resilience.

Group Head of Validation
Welcome to our dynamic and forward-thinking team! We are on the lookout for a Head of Validation who is ready to develop and lead our validation function with enthusiasm and a fresh perspective. If you are passionate about model validation and capital modelling more generally, and want to make a real impact, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
What You'll Do:
As a Head of Validation, you will play a crucial role in the team, working closely with experienced professionals to develop and grow our model validation capabilities. Your key responsibilities will include:
- Oversight and management responsibility for Model Risk Management, alongside leadership of the Validation function
- Develop the overall model validation scope and plan, managing the scope and costs of any external reviews commissioned.
- Act as the subject matter expert on the Solvency II/UK regulatory requirements, PRA & GFSC rulebooks and the frameworks used in assessing model risks and wider regulatory compliance
- Deliver against the plan of activities, maintaining and developing the Solvency II/UK validation, model risk and regulatory compliance frameworks, polices and standards.
- Consolidate results from model validation activities and present progress and findings to the relevant Committees and Boards.
- Maintain and amend the model validation scope and plan against a range of triggers events or changes within the business, supporting any major model change protocols.
- Collaborate with the Chief Actuary, Chief Risk Officer, and Head of Capital on wider review of methodology and assumptions in respect of internal models.
- Support the business with Risk and Capital Assessments for new products, businesses and propositions where appropriate.
- Monitor and report on all material validation findings across the Group to the relevant committees and boards
- Support the financial risk appetite process, with appropriate early warning indicators, triggers and limits and reporting mechanisms.
- Input into both the stress and scenario testing for the Group and the wider ORSA process.
Key Skills, Qualifications and Experience
Essential Skills and Experience
- Qualified actuary with experience in Internal Model validation
- Strong understanding of Solvency II regulations
- Proven experience within General Insurance
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail
- Clear and effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts simply
- Collaborative approach, with a willingness to work across teams and contribute to a positive working environment
Desirable
- Curious and eager to learn, with a passion for staying current on industry trends
Why Join Us?
- Exciting Projects: Be part of innovative projects that challenge and inspire you.
- Professional Growth: Access to continuous learning opportunities.
- Supportive Environment: Work in a supportive and inclusive environment where your ideas are valued.
- Work-Life Balance: Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with flexible working arrangements.
- Fun Culture: Join a company and team that strives to make each working day fun and enjoyable.

Join Our Team as a Technical Claims Manager!
We are thrilled to announce an exciting opportunity for a Technical Claims Manager. Reporting directly to the Head of Technical Claims, this role will primarily focus on overseeing and managing high-value medical claims handled by a third-party provider. Your responsibilities will include advising on and approving these large claims, as well as performing regular reviews and checks on the third-party claims handler to ensure excellent customer service and effective claims cost management. Additionally, you will provide technical claims support to our in-house claims team, so a solid understanding of travel products is essential.
We are looking for a candidate with prior experience in managing similar claims, preferably in the travel medical assistance sector. You should be an ambitious and enthusiastic individual, capable of working independently while also sharing your expertise with others.
The claims environment is fast-paced, requiring quick decision-making on complex claims. Comfort in swiftly establishing the facts of each case is crucial for effective outcomes. This is an exciting time for our travel claims operation, as we are experiencing growth. Your role will be pivotal in ensuring strong controls and oversight for our highest-risk claims, ultimately leading to positive customer outcomes and effective cost management.
We are transitioning to a hybrid working model that blends office and remote work. While we prioritise finding the right candidate with the necessary skills and experience, we are open to discussing a flexible arrangement that balances time in our Cardiff office with remote work options.
Main Duties
- Oversee large-value medical claims beyond supplier authority, reviewing coverage and collaborating with medical providers.
- Handle emergency calls for claims decisions after hours, ensuring readiness for significant decisions on high-value claims.
- Conduct audits on supplier claims processes to ensure effective management, providing feedback and challenging as needed.
- Identify cost-saving opportunities during case management, pursuing innovative approaches to stand out from competitors.
- Stay updated on travel insurance market developments, attending conferences to identify challenges and competitors.
- Share market knowledge and expertise with colleagues to support their development.
- Manage communication with stakeholders on high-value claims for informed decision-making and optimal outcomes.
Experience and Qualifications Required
- A minimum of three years√¢¬Ä¬ô experience handling medical claims within a travel claims context.
- Preferably possess CII or equivalent qualifications, demonstrating commitment to continuous learning.
Skills
- Strong experience in travel insurance claims, especially medical assistance.
- Solid understanding of medical claims validation and policy application.
- Experience managing external medical suppliers and influencing performance.
- Excellent analytical skills for assessing complex cases and identifying trends.
- Ability to use performance data to improve outcomes and control costs.
- Outstanding communication skills for collaboration with stakeholders.
- Capable of sharing technical knowledge and mentoring team members.
- Confident in making technical decisions on complex claims.
- Good understanding of claims governance and regulatory requirements.
- Skilled at managing competing priorities in a dynamic environment.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and claims management systems.
- Adaptable and committed to ongoing personal and professional development.

- Drive continuous improvement in financial risk management practices.

- Proven financial risk management experience within general insurance pricing and underwriting.

- Experience operating within a regulated financial services environment.

- Understanding of regulatory, sustainability and reinsurance frameworks.

- Collaborate with Principal Engineers and Squad Leads to align engineering work with wider platform goals.

The Guidewire Solution Architect is part of the Architecture practice within the CTO organisation, supporting the design and delivery of end-to-end solutions across Admiral√¢¬Ä¬ôs core insurance platforms, digital customer channels and integration landscape.
The role provides technology consultancy, architecture leadership and solution design expertise, with primary focus on Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, Digital Portal and Customer Engagement solutions. Working closely with Lead Solution Architects, Engineering teams, Product Owners, Delivery Leads, Heads of Technology and Business Stakeholders, the role ensures that solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with Admiral√¢¬Ä¬ôs Enterprise Architecture Principles, Technology Roadmaps and Strategic Vision.
The role contributes to enterprise roadmaps, architecture standards, governance forums and wider transformation initiatives, helping to ensure that change delivered through projects, programmes, value streams and innovation initiatives delivers business value while maintaining alignment with Admiral√¢¬Ä¬ôs target architecture and strategic technology direction.
Key Responsibilities
- Provide technical leadership and architecture support for value streams, working with Lead Solution Architects to own solutions from ideation through to delivery and ensure business value is realised through successful implementation.
- Define end-to-end solution architectures spanning Guidewire platforms, Digital Channels, Integration Platforms, Enterprise Services and supporting technology ecosystems.
- Provide architectural leadership for Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and digital customer-facing solutions.
- Define solution approaches for Guidewire product configuration, integration design, platform extensions, customer journeys and digital capabilities.
- Lead architecture workshops with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, assess impacts, evaluate solution options and drive architectural decisions.
- Lead and contribute to governance forums, ensuring solutions adhere to established architecture principles, standards and patterns, and identifying and managing divergence where required.
- Define integration strategies between Guidewire platforms and enterprise applications using APIs, messaging, event-driven architectures and enterprise integration patterns.
- Support strategic initiatives, platform modernisation programmes and technology transformation activities across the insurance landscape.
- Produce high-quality architecture artefacts, including Solution Outlines, High Level Designs, Architecture Decision Records, Option Papers, conceptual and logical architecture designs, integration designs, technical risk assessments and roadmaps.
- Ensure architectural decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks, principles and non-functional requirements are documented and communicated effectively across stakeholders.
- Work closely with engineering teams to ensure architectural intent is maintained throughout delivery and implementation.
- Identify and manage architectural risks, technical debt, technology constraints and cross-programme dependencies.
- Build productive relationships with business and technical stakeholders to maintain alignment between business objectives and technology strategy.
- Contribute to and maintain a detailed understanding of the architecture landscape across supported value streams.
- Contribute to the architecture repository using Admiral architecture modelling tools, standards and language.
- Promote architecture best practice within Admiral and support the continuous evolution of enterprise architecture standards and patterns.
- Support innovation through research and evaluation of emerging technologies and industry trends, producing recommendations on opportunities, threats and strategic technology direction.
- Keep the Head of Solution Architecture and CTO leadership informed of significant architecture risks, issues, dependencies and strategic considerations.
Essential Skills and Experience
- Strong experience architecting solutions using Guidewire PolicyCenter and BillingCenter.
- Proven experience designing end-to-end enterprise solutions within Guidewire ecosystems, balancing business requirements, platform capabilities and architecture standards.
- Experience supporting Guidewire upgrades, migrations and platform modernisation programmes.
- Strong understanding of Guidewire platform architecture and associated design principles.
- Experience with Guidewire configuration concepts, including Product Configuration, Product Designer, Business Rules, Workflows, Data Model Extensions, Screen Configuration, User Experience Design, Rating and Underwriting concepts.
- Experience defining architecture and design approaches for Guidewire customisation, extension and configuration while promoting adoption of out-of-the-box platform capabilities.
- Experience designing and reviewing integrations between Guidewire platforms and enterprise applications.
- Strong understanding of Guidewire integration capabilities, including REST APIs, web services, messaging frameworks, batch interfaces and event-driven integrations.
- Experience designing solutions involving Guidewire platforms, Digital Channels, Customer Portals and Enterprise Services.
- Strong understanding of API architecture, integration patterns, messaging architectures and service-oriented design principles.
- Experience with one or more enterprise integration technologies such as TIBCO, MuleSoft, Azure or GCP Integration Services, or Kafka-based platforms.
- Experience designing enterprise solutions that satisfy security, resilience, scalability, performance, supportability and operational requirements.

We are looking for an experienced and business-driven professional to join our AAGI P&C Underwriting team as Manager √¢¬Ä¬ì Non-Motor Product & Business, Underwriting, Reinsurance & Governance . In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end management of assigned non-motor insurance products, ensuring strong underwriting governance, regulatory compliance, portfolio performance, and sustainable business growth. You will also play a key role in supporting reinsurance and natural catastrophe (NatCat) management initiatives while working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Product & Portfolio Management
- Lead end-to-end product management for assigned non-motor insurance lines across various distribution channels.
- Drive product development, enhancement, and innovation to maintain market competitiveness.
- Apply underwriting guidelines and risk selection criteria to achieve profitable and sustainable growth.
- Monitor portfolio performance and recommend improvement actions based on business insights.
- Conduct portfolio analysis and provide data-driven recommendations to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
- Ensure products comply with internal policies, underwriting standards, and regulatory requirements.
Reinsurance & NatCat Management
- Support reinsurance renewals, data preparation, structuring inputs, and coordination with reinsurers and brokers.
- Monitor portfolio exposure and support natural catastrophe (NatCat) risk assessments.
- Ensure accuracy and timeliness of exposure, premium, and loss data submissions.
- Provide portfolio insights to support risk optimization and sustainable business performance.
Governance & Compliance
- Ensure compliance with underwriting governance, product governance, and regulatory requirements.
- Manage product filing processes and maintain accurate documentation.
- Support underwriting quality reviews and promote consistency with internal standards and guidelines.
Stakeholder Management
- Collaborate closely with Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, Finance, and Distribution teams to deliver business objectives.
- Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including brokers and reinsurers.
- Ensure timely, accurate, and high-quality execution of assigned projects and initiatives.
Must Have
- Bachelor√¢¬Ä¬ôs degree in insurance, Business Administration, Finance, Actuarial Science, or a related field.
- Minimum 7 years of experience in non-life insurance , preferably within non-motor product lines.
- Strong background in product management, underwriting, and portfolio analysis.
- Exposure to reinsurance and NatCat management would be an advantage.
- Understanding of underwriting governance, product governance, and regulatory requirements.
Nice to Have
- Experience in data analysis, portfolio monitoring, MIS, or management reporting.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively across functions.
- Good command of written and spoken English
- Any AI-future skills e.g., ChatGPT, or CoPilot365, will be advantage.

Role Description
Allianz Personal are looking for a Pricing Manager to join our Retail Team. We're seeking a true expert who will take the responsibility for delivering the financial targets of our Home products being distributed via our Partnerships network.
Based in our London or Birmingham offices on a hybrid basis, you'll work closely with the wider Pricing team to help us shape the future path of Pricing by integrating our models into customer rating and accurately manage the insurance risk of the business we write.
The role sits within the Retail Pricing Portfolio team, and involves managing a team of analysts, as well as forming relationships across numerous teams and departments within both AZP and Allianz Group.
About You
Your role will vary day to day, but here is a bit of what you can expect:
- Deputising for the relevant Head of Partnerships Pricing, and contributing to the product underwriting strategy.
- Defining and delivering pricing analysis projects to improve underwriting performance whilst supporting GWP targets through competitive product/price positioning.
- Involved in the tendering and onboarding of new partners, as well as developing and improving the performance on existing partners.
- Inputting into product development, by primarily identifying innovative underwriting segmentation improvements to support volume growth and profitability ambitions.
- Establishing a robust rate relativity review process to optimise the conversion and profitability of individual risk segments within the portfolio.
- Reviewing√Ç¬†overall product and individual scheme profitability, providing necessary pricing input into the budget planning process for existing lines, and the evaluation of new schemes or partnership bids.
Essential Skills
- Solid pricing portfolio expertise with experience in challenging the status quo to introduce innovation
- Experience within pricing and delivering the financial targets using Risk Premium models from other teams, coupled with commercial awareness of the Home market.
- Previous exposure to the use of Radar, Databricks and Machine Learning models or transferable equivalents in an insurance setting.
- Experience of managing and mentoring junior team members, as well as being a role model.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships across pricing teams and other business functions.
Desirable Skills
- Ideally, you'll have previous experience with the Home insurance product, however we'll consider candidates from other backgrounds such as Motor or other types of Home insurance.
- Prior experience or strong awareness of Pricing Optimisation techniques and how it can impact on best rates to go to market.
- Responsible AI Usage

job_title: Regional Head of GBO Asia and Operations Delivery, Transformation and Governance Lead
full_description:
Job Purpose/Summary:
This role is based in Singapore. The Regional Head of GBO Asia is accountable for end-to-end operational delivery across all structured and high-volume processing activities within the Asia region, covering all lines of business in alignment with agreed Service Level Agreements. The role leads onshore delivery teams across Asia, drives regional implementation of the GBO Target Operating Model, and acts as the senior operational partner to regional Underwriting, Claims, Finance, Accounting and broker stakeholders. The role supervises delivery from offshore locations, in close collaboration with GBO Global teams and Domain leads in particular.
The role carries a dual mandate: in addition to core operational delivery leadership, the Regional Head of GBO Asia owns the regional transformation agenda and the regional operations governance framework - combining transformation velocity with governance rigour. This includes ownership of the regional risk and controls environment, Business Continuity Management, operational reporting quality, and the end-to-end transformation roadmap for GBO Asia.
The role operates in a matrix structure, with a solid line to the Regional Head of Operations and a dotted line to the Global Head of GBO.√Ç¬† Regional Head of GBO Asia ensures full integration between GBO's global priorities and the broader Asia business agenda.
The role operates within the GBO global Target Operating Model and is accountable for its faithful regional implementation. Regional adaptation is permitted within defined boundaries, but deviation from global standards, frameworks and blueprints requires explicit approval from the Global Head of GBO.
Regional Heads are key enablers of GBO's global strategy. Consistency across regions is the foundation for scale, efficiency and leverage of the global shared capacity model.
Key Responsibilities:
Operations Management
- Own end-to-end operational delivery for the Asia region across all business lines, ensuring SLAs, quality standards and KPIs are consistently met.
- Manage a regional portfolio of significant GWP, with accountability for both onshore teams and matrix shared management of offshore delivery capacity across India, Singapore, Hong Kong and other Asia locations.
- Implement and maintain full adherence to the GBO global Target Operating Model, process governance standards and operational blueprints - regional execution must not deviate from globally defined frameworks without formal approval from the Global Head of GBO.
- Build and sustain effective working relationships with regional Underwriting, Claims, Finance and broker stakeholders across Asia markets.
- Actively participate in the Regional Extended Leadership Team, representing GBO's operational agenda and ensuring alignment between global GBO priorities and Asia business needs.
- Represent GBO in regional leadership forums and act as the senior operational voice in Asia.
People Leadership
- Lead, develop and manage regional teams including Team Leaders, with full accountability for performance management, capacity planning and talent development across Asia
- Drive a high-performance culture aligned to Allianz values and GBO's One Team One Model principle, reflecting the cultural diversity of the Asia region.
- Support hiring, succession planning and career development in close collaboration with HR.
- Foster collaboration across regional and global GBO teams, including offshore shared delivery locations.
- Set clear targets, manage performance and develop career pathways for all team members.
- Actively apply and contribute to the GBO global career pathing framework by identifying talent, mapping development pathways and ensuring regional teams have visibility of growth opportunities across the global GBO network.
Process & Performance Management
- Define, implement and manage operational KPIs and SLAs to measure and continuously improve regional performance, in alignment with the global GBO performance framework.
- Align regional KPIs and reporting to the global GBO performance framework and contribute to global benchmarking and best practice sharing across regions.
- Conduct regular business reviews with underwriting and operational partners, using data-driven insights.
- Identify and drive process improvement and lean initiatives, sharing best practices across GBO globally.
- Ensure full productivity accountability for all teams under direct and matrix management.
- Collaborate with regional and global functions on cross-functional operational topics.
Transformation & Change Management
- Lead and own regional delivery of globally mandated transformation programmes, with full accountability to the global programme governance structure
- Own the GBO Asia transformation agenda end-to-end - from opportunity identification through execution and sustained delivery of measurable efficiency improvements
- Develop and maintain the GBO Asia transformation roadmap, aligned with the global Target Operating Model and GBO's strategic priorities, incorporating local regulatory and market context across Asia-Pacific
- Build business cases for regional transformation investments with quantified benefits; maintain portfolio-level oversight of all regional transformation initiatives
- Drive transformation governance for GBO Asia through regional SteerCo and working groups; provide structured progress reporting to global transformation leadership
- Serve as GBO Asia's representative in global transformation forums; ensure regional learnings and innovations are captured and fed into the global pipeline
- Lead process redesign and harmonisation across GBO Asia lines of business, eliminating operational fragmentation and aligning with the global Target Operating Model
- Identify and prioritise automation opportunities across GBO Asia operations; lead implementation of RPA, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled workflows
- Champion AI adoption within GBO Asia - supporting use case development including Agentic AI applications and contributing to the GBO AI Champions network
- Pilot regional automation and AI use cases; package successful pilots for global scaling in partnership with the global transformation team
- Develop and maintain an environment that enables offshoring and nearshoring initiatives to progress in line with the global shared capacity model
- Design and execute change management strategies for GBO Asia transformation initiatives, reflecting the cultural and operational diversity of the region.
Operations Governance
- Own the GBO Asia operational risk and controls framework, ensuring alignment with GBO's global control environment and enterprise risk appetite; define, document and monitor controls across key operational processes including task transfer, data handling and third-party dependencies.
- Partner with Compliance, Internal Audit and Risk functions to align the regional control framework with regulatory obligations across all Asia locations; drive periodic control testing and self-assessment cycles, tracking findings to closure with clear accountability.
- Maintain the GBO Asia risk register and escalate material operational risks to GBO leadership in a timely and structured manner; build a risk-aware culture through clear escalation paths and embedded first-line-of-defence practices.
- Own the GBO Asia Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework for both onshore and offshore delivery locations; develop, maintain and test BCM plans covering a wide variety of scenarios; conduct regular tabletop exercises and act as the primary GBO interface for Group BCM and local Country Risk teams across Asia.
- Own the GBO Asia operational reporting framework; govern the dashboard ecosystem, set quality standards, ensure data integrity and drive adoption across delivery units and business partners.
- Maintain a harmonised KPI taxonomy across GBO Asia, eliminating fragmented or inconsistent metrics; lead quarterly operational performance reviews and synthesise insights for senior regional stakeholders.
- Drive continuous improvement and efficient processing to achieve best-in-class operational standards.
- Ensure innovations and process improvements adopted locally are validated against global GBO standards before implementation, to preserve consistency and scalability across the GBO network.
Global Responsibilities & Contribution
- Adopt and embed global process standards within Asia to drive consistency, scalability and operational leverage across all GBO locations.
- Champion and implement global automation and agentic AI solutions within GBO Asia, ensuring timely adoption and contributing to scaling across the GBO network.
- Actively contribute to global GBO initiatives and projects as a regional subject matter expert, ensuring Asia regional needs are reflected in global design decisions.
- Drive the evolution of the offshoring operating model towards a higher proportion of shared delivery and shared capacity, strengthening resilience and adaptability to seasonality across regions.
- Contribute to building a globally consistent, scalable GBO delivery model that enables efficiency, cost leverage and quality through shared capabilities.
- Ensure that regional teams are fully briefed on and compliant with global GBO governance policies, operating procedures and quality standards - local workarounds that undermine global consistency are not permitted.
Key Experience / Requirements / Skills:
Required Experience
- Minimum 10+ years in operational management in (re)insurance or financial services, with demonstrated accountability for large-scale, multi-country operations in Asia.
- Significant experience leading operational transformation, process redesign and automation / AI adoption programmes at scale in an Asia-Pacific context.
- Experience designing or owning operational risk/controls frameworks and/or BCM plans in an offshore delivery context (India captive model experience preferred).
- Demonstrated experience at senior leadership level in a global matrix organisation, contributing to global initiatives and executive-level stakeholder engagement.
- Proven track record leading high-performing international teams across onshore and offshore locations in Asia, including matrix management of 50+ FTEs.
Requried Education
- University degree (preferably in business administration, economics, finance, mathematics or law) or equivalent insurance specific qualification.
- MBA preferred or other Masters degree.
Technical Skills

Within Allianz SE, Group Risk (GR) is in charge of managing risks to bolster Allianz's financial strength and to support value-focused company leadership. As such Group Risk is responsible for monitoring, managing and reporting on the Group's overall risk profile. In this context, the Independent Validation Unit is the central global validation function, being responsible for independently validating internal models across many risk types in the context of Solvency II. In your role as a validator you support the Independent Validation Unit team with validating models and coordinating the group-wide major model change process with our Operating entities within Enterprise Risk, Governance & Control department at Allianz SE. - Managing the model change process in close collaboration with senior management and supervisory authorities

As a risk consultant, you will work closely with underwriting, claims, distribution and communications to service assigned accounts. You will actively support the growth of our broader Natural Resources portfolio such as expanding our expertise in renewable energies and sustainable operations as well as broadening our outreach to clients in the conventional power sector.
This role is remote but candidates must physically reside in one of the following states to service regional clients: Illinois, Georgia, Texas or New York.
Your Team
Allianz Commercial specializes in providing comprehensive and customized insurance and inspection products, services, and solutions for companies in the energy industry. We have a wealth of technical excellence in managing engineering and energy risks around the world. We are well equipped to meet the most demanding challenges in the energy insurance landscape and are actively addressing climate change across all segments.
We are focused on expanding our presence in renewable energy and green technologies, as well as contributing to the emerging global hydrogen economy. From large sites, to the most challenging projects, we provide comprehensive insurance and inspection solutions during both the construction and operational phases.
Our Allianz Risk Consulting (ARC) team is made up of experienced engineers from a wide range of technical and scientific disciplines. The team provides a flexible range of risk consulting services, from natural hazards, fire safety, and human and organizational risk factors to in-depth analysis of industry operations, and financial exposures, across all industry sectors and risks. We also focus on delivering bespoke training plans to help our clients to optimize risk management procedures in the long term.
The Impact You Will Have
Reporting to the Natural Resources Risk Consulting Manager, this role is responsible for providing loss control expertise, support and assistance to AzC and its customers, to assist Allianz underwriting in risk selection and retention. Provide ongoing co-ordination and monitoring of the loss control activity / servicing of assigned accounts & loss control survey work to assist with servicing of assigned accounts. Develop and maintain professional working relationships with Underwriting, Market Management, Communications, Claims, clients and brokers. Maintain and enhance technical skills and expertise in respective field to support the business
Some of your specific responsibilities could include:
- Complete desk top reviews and risk assessments (pre & post loss) for underwriting evaluating and summarizing exposures and controls.
- Work with underwriting, claims, the client and the broker where appropriate to develop customized loss control programs including locations to be surveyed (or included as part of continuing service), scope and cost of risk consulting services.
- Generate and review required reports and recommendations. Meet reporting deadlines in accordance with departmental performance objectives.
- Survey client operations obtain appropriate data, identify hazards, discuss findings with appropriate parties. Generate loss control reports, recommendations etc.
- Appoint / monitor 3rd parties ensuring adequate contract / controls in place with budgets agreed up front. Check and ensure quality of work provided by 3rd parties.
- Assist AzC and clients with respect to ongoing or specific projects. Support technical training presentations for internal and external clients as required / appropriate.
What You√¢¬Ä¬ôll Bring to the Role √¢¬Ä¬ì
- Minimum 7 years√¢¬Ä¬ô loss prevention engineering experience in an area relevant to his/her lob
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering. Or Bachelor's degree in another related discipline or Engineering discipline that is associated with your lob will be considered in conjunction with extensive technical expertise in the natural resources risk consulting engineering and insurance industry.
- Good knowledge and professional experience in operational conventional power and utility occupancies such as: gas turbines, diesels, hydros/tidal, biomass, nuclear, geothermal (non-drilling exposures), and thermal solar.
- Good knowledge and professional experience in renewable energy occupancies such as: wind, solar photovoltaic (PV), battery energy storage system (BESS), hydrogen, hydro, and carbon capture.
- Good knowledge and professional experience in various business sectors. Experience or background in managing/coordinating large global corporate accounts within various occupancy sectors.
- Experience in field and desktop evaluation and assessment of risks, including development of loss estimates and risk engineering solutions.
- A demonstrable engineering/technical expertise. Commitment to maintaining knowledge of developments and new technologies in field.
- Able to work technical loss control topics with knowledge of specific business sectors.
- Good knowledge of the MS365 environment, AI tools, data analytics and visualization techniques as well as NATCAT modeling principles.
- Self-motivated, with the ability to work effectively in both home office and team environments.
- Proactive change agent, adapting with ease and promoting among peers the adoption of new technologies, processes and working methods.
- Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills. Presentation skills in a varied environment. Organizational and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to travel throughout the US, with the potential for some Canada or international travel.
- The ability to utilize AI tools to support day-today tasks, improve efficiency, and contribute to data-driven decision-making is valuable. A willingness to learn and explore how AI can enhance your role and the broader organization is expected.
External applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employment-based sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time, nor can we guarantee future sponsorship.
The annualized base pay range for this role are as follows:
Georgia: $102,182 - $154,364
Illinois/Texas: $112,818 - $170,509
New York: $130, 273 - $196,891
The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position may be above and will be determined by several factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role, the skills, education, training, credentials, and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the AzC total compensation package. As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

Allianz Commercial (AzC) is one of the largest marine insurers in the world and is a leader in inland marine insurance and related property coverage across North America and various worldwide locations. This role establishes and operates the FinOps operating rhythm across the organisation, building unit economics, forecasting with discipline, aligning budgets to business outcomes, and driving an optimisation backlog that steadily lowers total cost of ownership √¢¬Ä¬î all while maintaining or improving service quality and SLA performance. The FinOps Manager works at the intersection of ITIL v4 Service Financial Management and Capacity & Performance Management, ensuring that every euro spent on technology is traceable, justified, and optimised.
Key Responsibilities
- Design, implement, and operate the Allianz FinOps operating model: define policies, governance, roles, and cadences (monthly cost reviews, quarterly planning, annual budgeting) across cloud and hybrid infrastructure.

- Negotiate and optimise cloud provider contracts, Enterprise Agreements, and SaaS licence renewals in partnership with Procurement and Vendor Management.
- Establish and track FinOps maturity metrics: commitment coverage rate, waste reduction percentage, forecast accuracy, unit cost trend, and anomaly detection response time.

- Collaborate with ITIL Service Financial Management to ensure IT cost data supports regulatory reporting (Solvency II, DORA), internal audit, and Group-level financial consolidation.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion
Coface is fully committed to creating a work atmosphere that respects the individualities and diversity of its teams. En Majadahonda, Comunidad de Madrid.

Integración y normalización de nuevas fuentes de eventos en plataformas de monitorización (Splunk + SENTINEL).

Automatización + Orquestación de alertas.

It brings together business and technology in cross-functional teams, enabling us to respond faster to changing customer needs, accelerate innovation, and to continuously develop our products, offerings, services and customer experiences.
Today, more than 1,500 professionals at If operate within this model across the Nordics and Baltics. As a result, the digital operating model is not simply a way of working - it is a key capability that shapes how we deliver business outcomes, leverage our scale, and maintain our competitive position in an increasingly digital insurance market.
About the role
As Head of Digital Operating Model & Development Excellence at If, you will be driving the evolution of one of the largest digital operating models in the Nordics & Baltics.
You will lead a newly established function that brings together key enablers including Operational Development Managers, Ifs Agile Center of Excellence and DevOps Center of Excellence. The line responsibility consists of ~25 professionals, with a broad range of competences such as leaders, strategists, engineers and agile coaches. - Lead the strategic development of If√¢¬Ä¬ôs digital operating model, ensuring it continues to evolve in line with business priorities, customer needs, and technology opportunities. Define, prioritize and drive change, ranging from incremental improvements to significant initiatives
- Lead and support steering and governance processes to ensure strategic priorities are executed effectively and progress is tracked
- Engage and collaborate with key stakeholders across Business Areas, IT, and enabling functions
- Developing the agile ways of working and engineering excellence across tribes and squads
Who you are
You are a strong and inspiring leader with the ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You thrive in complex environments and are motivated by driving change and creating real impact at a high pace. Your leadership is characterized by clarity, trust, and a strong ability to create alignment across the organization.
To succeed in this role, you bring:
- A do-er mentality, together with proven experience in leading and driving change in complex environments, particularly within digital and agile transformations
- Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across all levels - from executive top management to tribes & squads
- Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect operating model development to business outcomes

full_description:

Analysis of trends and developments and preparation of clear conclusions and recommendations
Running reports, including in Power BI

Excel and Power BI
PowerPoint for communicating analyses and insights
Python or SQL
English, especially in writing

Do you want to use your speaking skills and people skills at a high level? Can you create enthusiasm and motivation in others? Then you might be our new Sales Coach at Tryg CardsAffinity.

 

About Us | Tryg

Tryg CardsAffinity is a flexible, dynamic and innovative insurance provider that develops tailor-made add-on product insurance, extended warranty products, cancellation insurance, ID theft insurance and service and support solutions, which are sold through leading partners throughout the Nordic region and Germany.

 

We have a central Northern European set-up, where sales, implementation and claims handling are represented in all four Nordic countries. a Danish sales coach, you will be responsible for training employees at our retail partners, such as 3, Humac, Skousen/Whiteaway and Power, in the sale of insurance. Your everyday life will vary, depending on how your meetings are organized. However, you can expect to have to drive out to partners four days a week, and also have one day for administration.

 

About You | Independent and goal-oriented
In order to be successful in the position, you must be able to work independently, in a structured way and maintain a good overview of your meetings. We would like you to:

Have experience in sales, coaching and/or retail
Thrive in a fast-paced work environment
Comes with positive energy that can engage and motivate
It is not a requirement that you have an education in insurance, but it is a requirement that you have a driver's license. Since you will primarily be driving out to partners in the western part of the country, we would prefer that you live in that part of the country.

Do you want to work with consulting and relationship-building sales, where the interest has already been created for you? At Tryg Partnersalg, you work with customers who already know Tryg or have shown interest in our solutions through one of our partners. This allows you to focus on creating good customer experiences, strong results and advice that creates security.

 

As we are continuously looking for new sales talents for our teams in Partner Sales, we are always interested in talking to new potential colleagues with an interest in sales and consulting. You can therefore apply now and be considered for both current and future classes.

 

About the job | Sales, quality and customer satisfaction

As an insurance advisor at Tryg Partnersalg, you work with outbound sales to both new and existing customers. You take the dialogue further with customers who already have a relationship with Tryg or have shown interest in our solutions.

 

This means that you can focus on understanding the customer's needs and turning dialogue into results rather than having to create interest from scratch. At the same time, you work in a KPI-driven everyday life, where you are measured on sales, quality and customer satisfaction.

 

Your primary tasks are to:

Advise and sell insurance policies by phone, email, and online meetings
Work with qualified customers and translate dialogue into sales
Ensure high quality advice and strong customer satisfaction
Work purposefully with KPIs in sales and performance

About You | Ambitious and result-oriented salesperson

To succeed in the role, it is important that you are motivated by sales and thrive in an everyday life where your results are visible and measurable. You work in a structured way with your goals and follow your customers all the way to completion. At the same time, you are able to create security in your customer conversations and translate trust into concrete solutions.

 

We imagine that you:

Have experience with sales from e.g. call center, retail or similar
Thrive in a KPI-driven everyday life with clear goals
Has a strong drive and a pronounced winning mentality
Are curious about feedback and want to develop

Perform regulatory risk assessments and ensure appropriate documentation of results.
Coordinate the preparation of evidence and documentation required for internal and external audits as well as regulatory inspections.
Conduct gap analyses and monitor the implementation of regulatory remediation measures.

full_description:
√∞¬ü¬ö¬Ä About the Team
The Group FP&A team is a small, high-impact team at the heart of Wakam√¢¬Ä¬ôs financial steering and strategic decision-making.
Its role is to provide Executive Management and operational leaders with clear, reliable and forward-looking financial insights , while supporting budgeting, forecasting, monthly reporting, quarterly closings, cost control, consolidation and continuous improvement of Finance processes and tools.
As FP&A Analyst √¢¬Ä¬ì Expenses Controlling & Consolidation , you report directly to the FP&A Director and work closely with Accounting, Cash, Group Finance, operational leaders, VPs, Chiefs and budget owners across Wakam.
This is a senior individual contributor role with strong visibility and direct impact on how Wakam monitors, explains and optimises its cost base across the French perimeter.
√∞¬ü¬é¬Ø Your Mission
The mission of the FP&A Analyst √¢¬Ä¬ì Expenses Controlling & Consolidation is to deliver accurate, insightful and actionable financial analysis to support Executive Management and business leaders in their decision-making.
The role owns end-to-end expenses controlling across Wakam√¢¬Ä¬ôs French entities, covering consolidation of the French perimeter, expense analysis by nature, department and destination, cost allocation, intercompany rebilling, budgeting, forecasting and business partnering with budget owners.
This position is key to ensuring robust financial planning, reliable reporting and disciplined cost management across the organisation.
√¢¬ú¬è√Ø¬∏¬è Your Responsibilities
Business Partnering
- Act as the day-to-day Finance business partner for operational and support function leaders, including Chiefs, VPs and budget owners , on their expenses scope.
- This includes helping teams understand their financial results, translating budget versus actuals into clear business language, and supporting them in steering their cost base.
- The role also involves constructively challenging spending requests, budget submissions and reforecasts to ensure alignment with Wakam√¢¬Ä¬ôs strategy, priorities and financial trajectory.
- Building trust-based relationships with stakeholders is central to the position, in order to anticipate business needs, identify risks and opportunities early, and influence decision-making through clear financial insight.
Expenses Controlling & Allocation
- For each monthly reporting, quarterly closing, budget and forecast cycle, the role is responsible for setting up, monitoring and analysing expense reporting across the full French perimeter.
- The analysis covers expenses by nature, department, cost centre, destination, entity and consolidated French perimeter .
- A key part of the role is to build and challenge expense budgets and forecasts for operational and support functions across French entities. This includes reviewing allocation assumptions, intercompany rebilling plans and consistency with Wakam√¢¬Ä¬ôs strategy.
- The role also covers variance analysis by nature, destination and entity, definition of action plans with budget owners, and follow-up of implementation.
- A strong contribution to cost optimisation is expected, with a focus on spend efficiency, savings tracking and financial discipline.
French Perimeter Consolidation & Intercompany Management
- Centralise, review and consolidate expense data from all French entities, ensuring full perimeter coverage and proper reconciliation with Accounting.
- The role helps ensure consistency across management practices, chart of accounts, cost allocation rules, intercompany flows and intragroup rebillings .
- It also owns the alignment of intercompany flows and intragroup rebillings, including identification, reconciliation and elimination.
- Consolidated expense analyses by entity, nature and destination are produced in collaboration with the FP&A team, with recommendations to improve financial performance, reporting quality and cost allocation processes.
Continuous Improvement & Tools
- The role contributes to the professionalisation and scaling of the controlling function.
- This includes improving reporting, closing and planning processes , as well as making the best use of Finance tools such as Sage, Pigment and other reporting solutions.
- A strong focus is placed on automating reporting, improving data reliability, reducing manual work and proposing new performance indicators that are relevant to the business.
- The position also supports the use of AI, automation and digital tools to streamline recurring tasks, improve variance analysis and enable faster, more reliable decision-making.
√∞¬ü¬ß¬† What You Bring
The ideal candidate brings at least 5 years of experience in FP&A, controlling or financial planning , ideally with a strong focus on expenses controlling, cost allocation and multi-entity consolidation .
- Strong analytical and synthesis skills are essential, with the ability to make complex financial topics understandable for non-finance stakeholders.
- The role requires confidence in acting as a trusted business partner to operational and senior stakeholders, providing day-to-day support while constructively challenging assumptions, spending requests and action plans.
- Advanced Excel skills and strong command of financial systems and tools are required. Experience with Sage and/or Pigment is a plus.
- Experience in the insurance sector is an advantage, but not mandatory.
- Fluency in English , both written and spoken, is required in this international environment.
Strong experience is expected in:
- Expense controlling
- Budgeting and forecasting
- Variance analysis
- Cost allocation
- Intercompany flows and rebillings
- Multi-entity financial reporting
- Consolidated analysis and management reporting
√¢¬ú¬® Who You Are
- You are a strong Finance professional combining rigour, business curiosity and stakeholder impact .
- Structured, autonomous and reliable, you bring a strong sense of ownership and know how to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and international environment.
- You enjoy working closely with business teams, helping them understand financial performance and supporting better decision-making.
- You are also comfortable challenging stakeholders constructively, using data, analysis and business understanding to support your recommendations.
- A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a genuine interest in improving processes, tools and collaboration will be key to success in this role.
√¢¬ú¬® √∞¬ü¬§¬ñ AI & Digital Mindset
At Wakam, AI, automation and digital transformation are reshaping how Finance works.
This role offers the opportunity to use digital and AI-enabled tools to streamline recurring reporting tasks, improve data consolidation and variance analysis, automate management reporting, strengthen cost allocation and reconciliation processes, and build more reliable financial insights.
No technical AI expertise is required. What matters most is curiosity, adaptability and willingness to learn , combined with a strong Finance mindset and a desire to improve the way things work.
√∞¬ü¬å¬ü Why Join Wakam?
Joining Wakam as FP&A Analyst √¢¬Ä¬ì Expenses Controlling & Consolidation means taking on a highly visible Finance role with direct impact on cost steering, financial discipline and strategic decision-making.
This role offers:
- An international and multicultural environment
- A high level of autonomy and responsibility
- Strong exposure to senior stakeholders and Executive Management
- The opportunity to contribute to the development of the Group Finance function
- Exposure to international projects and cross-functional initiatives
- A culture of innovation, continuous improvement and ownership
- Remote work flexibility within a modern, inclusive and dynamic company culture
This is a strong opportunity for a senior FP&A or controlling professional looking to combine business partnering, analytical depth, consolidation, cost optimisation and transformation in a fast-growing insurance company.
√∞¬ü¬è¬Ü Hiring Process
Our hiring process is designed to be transparent, efficient and respectful of your time .
The process will be confirmed with shortlisted candidates and may include:
- Initial interview with our Talent Acquisition team
- Interview with our Director FP&A
- Technical or business case discussion focused on expenses controlling, consolidation and stakeholder management
- Final HR interview with People Partner

√∞¬ü¬é¬Ø Your Mission

You will contribute to the reliability of financial operations and support continuous improvement, including the implementation and maintenance of our reinsurance management tool xLayer .

You will coordinate with Treasury on cash forecasting and liquidity planning, manage cash calls, collateral requirements and funds withheld accounts, and escalate payment issues√¢¬Ä¬îdriving resolution with reinsurers and/or brokers.
2) Reinsurance Financial Analysis & Reporting

√∞¬ü¬é¬Ø Your Mission
As a Reinsurance Technical Accountant , your mission is to execute and secure reinsurance accounting processes end-to-end: produce accurate and timely reinsurance account statements , maintain a reliable reinsurance sub-ledger , and ensure strong reconciliations and closing support . You have experience with reconciliations, closing processes, and audit evidence , and ideally exposure to insurance/reinsurance accounting (treaties, bordereaux, settlements, recoverables). You are comfortable working with Excel and finance systems, and you can collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders (brokers, reinsurers, Treasury, Reinsurance, Finance).
√¢¬ú¬® Who You Are

You also enjoy improving the way things work, not just executing them.

Reporting to the Head of Compliance & Regulatory, the Compliance Manager will be responsible for the hands-on delivery of compliance monitoring, regulatory reporting, and policy maintenance across ZIL‚Äôs operations. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can operate independently, apply sound judgement across a broad regulatory landscape, and act as a trusted second pair of eyes on regulatory matters. - Compliance monitoring- Own and execute the annual Compliance Monitoring Plan, including thematic reviews, sample testing, and control effectiveness assessments across underwriting, claims, distribution, and outsourcing.

- Policy and procedure maintenance- Draft, review, and update compliance policies and procedures to reflect regulatory change, business developments, and audit findings. Ensure version control and communication to the business.
- Consumer Duty and conduct risk- Support the Head of Compliance in monitoring fair value assessments, product governance obligations (PROD 4), complaints trends, and outcomes testing. Maintain the Consumer Duty evidence framework.
- MGA oversight- Contribute to the carrier‚Äôs oversight of the delegated underwriting authority, including reviewing MGA compliance reporting, attending outsourcing committees, and tracking DUA conditions and breaches.

- Board and committee reporting- Prepare compliance MI and papers for the Board, Risk Committee, and Outsourcing Committee. Ensure reporting is clear, decision-useful, and proportionate.

- Comfortable drafting regulatory submissions, compliance reports, and Board-ready papers.
